description:
Query colocalisation analysis results.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table colocalisation_coloc — one record = one COLOC colocalisation test between two credible sets.
Key: leftStudyLocusId, rightStudyLocusId.
Arguments: study_locus_id accepts study locus id (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown h4, clpp are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. COLOC tests run by OT 25.09 between overlapping credible sets; absence means not tested.

schema.description: Pass at least one of: method.

min_clpp.description: Keeps rows with clpp >= this value; unknown values never pass.

min_h4.description: Keeps rows with h4 >= this value; unknown values never pass.

study_locus_id.description: Accepts study_locus_id; resolved to one study_locus_id (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
